original_value: We propose an efficient anonymous, attribute-based credential scheme capable of provisioning multi-level credential delegations. It is integrated with a mechanism to revoke the anonymity of credentials for resolving access disputes and making users accountable for their actions. The proposed scheme has a lower end-user computational complexity in comparison to existing credential schemes with delegatability and has a comparable level of performance with the credential standards of U-Prove and Idemix. Furthermore, we demonstrate how the proposed scheme can be applied to a collaborative e-health environment to provide its users with the necessary anonymous access with delegation capabilities.

result.paraphrase: We present an efficient anonymous attribute-based credential scheme that supports multi-level credential delegation. It incorporates a mechanism for revoking credential anonymity to settle access disputes and hold users accountable for their actions. Compared with existing delegatable credential schemes, the proposed approach has lower computational complexity for end users, while offering performance comparable to the credential standards of U-Prove and Idemix. We also show how it can be used in a collaborative e-health setting to give users the anonymous access they need, along with delegation capabilities.
